Now let customers contact a business through its portal. They register with
`POST /api/v1/registrations`, for example
`{"user":{"name":"Avery","email":"avery@example.test","password":"my-customer-password"}}`.
They should use the existing verification, login, profile, and recovery flows.

A customer opens a request like this:

```http
POST /api/v1/requests

{"request":{"subject":"Cannot download my receipt","comment":{"body":"The download button does nothing."}}}
```

Return it inside `request`, with its ID, subject, status, requester ID, and timestamps. A new
request is open. Customers can list their own requests, open one, and read its comments at
`/requests`, `/requests/:id`, and `/requests/:id/comments`. Staff have the corresponding `/tickets`
routes; return records inside `ticket` there and include the requester as `{"id":10,"name":"Avery","email":"avery@example.test"}`.
Lists use the plural resource name. Comments include their body, author (`id` and `name`), whether
they're `public`, and when they were created.

Replies go through PATCH. For example, the owner can answer and mark a ticket pending:

```http
PATCH /api/v1/tickets/42

{"ticket":{"comment":{"body":"Please try again now."},"status":"pending"}}
```

Customers reply through `/requests/:id` with the `request` envelope. Customer replies reopen pending
or solved requests unless they mark the request solved in the same update. Staff can choose open, pending,
or solved. Posting a staff reply by itself doesn't change the status.

Paginate lists with `page` and `per_page` (default 1 and 25), returning `count`, `page`, `per_page`,
`next_page`, and `previous_page` alongside the records. Show recently active tickets and requests
first, and comments oldest first. This is a portal-only conversation for now; replies don't send email.

    class PasswordResetsController < BaseController
      before_action :require_account!
      before_action :require_active_account!

      def create
        reset_params = params.require(:password_reset)
        email = reset_params[:email].to_s.strip.downcase

        if email.blank?
          render json: { error: "Email is required" }, status: :unprocessable_entity
          return
        end

        user = current_account.users.find_by(email: email)
        if user
          token = user.generate_password_reset_token!
          UserMailer.password_reset(user, token).deliver_now
        end

        render json: { message: "If an account exists for that email, a password reset link has been sent." }, status: :ok
      end

      def confirm
        reset_params = params.require(:password_reset)
        token = reset_params[:token].to_s
        new_password = reset_params[:password].to_s

        user = current_account.users.find_by_password_reset_token(token)
        if user.nil?
          render json: { error: "Password reset token is invalid or has expired" }, status: :unprocessable_entity
          return
        end

        if new_password.blank?
          render json: { errors: { password: [ "can't be blank" ] } }, status: :unprocessable_entity
          return
        end

        user.password = new_password
        unless user.valid?
          render json: { errors: user.errors.messages }, status: :unprocessable_entity
          return

        user.reset_password!(new_password)
        render json: { message: "Password has been reset" }, status: :ok

    end

        end

      def authenticate_user!
        token = bearer_token
        if token.blank?
          render json: { error: "Unauthorized" }, status: :unauthorized

        end

        if session.nil? || session.user.account_id != current_account.id || !session.user.verified?
          render json: { error: "Unauthorized" }, status: :unauthorized
          return
        end

        @current_session = session
        @current_user = session.user
      end

        unless current_user&.staff?

        end

      def bearer_token
        auth = request.authorization.to_s

require "test_helper"

class HelpdeskPortalRequestsTest < ActionDispatch::IntegrationTest
  include ActiveSupport::Testing::TimeHelpers

  setup do
    ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.clear
  end

  def json_body
    JSON.parse(response.body)
  end

  def extract_token_from_last_email
    mail = ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.last
    assert_not_nil mail
    body = mail.text_part ? mail.text_part.body.decoded : mail.body.decoded
    match = body.match(/token=([^\s&"']+)/)
    assert_not_nil match, "Expected token in email body: #{body}"
    CGI.unescape(match[1])
  end

  def create_account_and_owner(subdomain: "acme", name: "Acme", email: "jo@acme.test", admin_name: "Jo", password: "owner-password")
    post "/api/v1/account/create",
      params: {
        account: {
          name: name,
          subdomain: subdomain,
          admin: {
            name: admin_name,
            email: email,
            password: password
          }
        }
      },
      as: :json
    assert_response :created
    owner_id = json_body.dig("user", "id")

    token = extract_token_from_last_email
    post "/api/v1/email_verifications/confirm",
      headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => subdomain },
      params: { email_verification: { token: token } },
      as: :json
    assert_response :ok

    post "/api/v1/sessions",
      headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => subdomain },
      params: { session: { email: email, password: password } },
      as: :json
    assert_response :created
    ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.clear
    [ json_body.dig("session", "token"), owner_id ]
  end

  def register_verify_signin_customer(subdomain: "acme", name: "Avery", email: "avery@example.test", password: "my-customer-password")
    post "/api/v1/registrations",
      headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => subdomain },
      params: {
        user: {
          name: name,
          email: email,
          password: password,
          role: "admin",
          verified: true
        }
      },
      as: :json
    assert_response :created
    assert_equal "customer", json_body.dig("user", "role")
    assert_equal false, json_body.dig("user", "verified")
    user_id = json_body.dig("user", "id")

    token = extract_token_from_last_email
    post "/api/v1/email_verifications/confirm",
      headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => subdomain },
      params: { email_verification: { token: token } },
      as: :json
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal true, json_body.dig("user", "verified")

    post "/api/v1/sessions",
      headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => subdomain },
      params: { session: { email: email, password: password } },
      as: :json
    assert_response :created
    ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.clear
    [ json_body.dig("session", "token"), user_id ]
  end

  test "customer registration uses existing verification, login, profile, and recovery flows" do
    create_account_and_owner

    # Missing or unknown account header rejected
    post "/api/v1/registrations",
      params: { user: { name: "Avery", email: "avery@example.test", password: "my-customer-password" } },
      as: :json
    assert_response :bad_request

    post "/api/v1/registrations",
      headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "unknown" },
      params: { user: { name: "Avery", email: "avery@example.test", password: "my-customer-password" } },
      as: :json
    assert_response :not_found

    # Register customer
    post "/api/v1/registrations",
      headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "acme" },
      params: {
        user: {
          name: "Avery",
          email: "avery@example.test",
          password: "my-customer-password",
          role: "admin",
          verified: true
        }
      },
      as: :json
    assert_response :created
    assert_equal "Avery", json_body.dig("user", "name")
    assert_equal "avery@example.test", json_body.dig("user", "email")
    assert_equal "customer", json_body.dig("user", "role")
    assert_equal false, json_body.dig("user", "verified")
    assert_equal 1, ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.size

    # Duplicate registration on same account rejected
    post "/api/v1/registrations",
      headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "acme" },
      params: { user: { name: "Avery 2", email: "AVERY@example.test", password: "my-customer-password" } },
      as: :json
    assert_response :unprocessable_entity

    # Unverified customer cannot sign in
    post "/api/v1/sessions",
      headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "acme" },
      params: { session: { email: "avery@example.test", password: "my-customer-password" } },
      as: :json
    assert_response :forbidden

    # Resend verification and confirm
    post "/api/v1/email_verifications",
      headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "acme" },
      params: { email_verification: { email: "avery@example.test" } },
      as: :json
    assert_response :ok
    ver_token = extract_token_from_last_email

    post "/api/v1/email_verifications/confirm",
      headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "acme" },
      params: { email_verification: { token: ver_token } },
      as: :json
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal true, json_body.dig("user", "verified")

    # Sign in and manage profile
    post "/api/v1/sessions",
      headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "acme" },
      params: { session: { email: "avery@example.test", password: "my-customer-password" } },
      as: :json
    assert_response :created
    customer_token = json_body.dig("session", "token")

    get "/api/v1/me",
      headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "acme", "Authorization" => "Bearer #{customer_token}" }
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal "customer", json_body.dig("user", "role")

    patch "/api/v1/me",
      headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "acme", "Authorization" => "Bearer #{customer_token}" },
      params: { user: { name: "Avery Chen", role: "admin" } },
      as: :json
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal "Avery Chen", json_body.dig("user", "name")
    assert_equal "customer", json_body.dig("user", "role")

    # Password recovery
    post "/api/v1/password_resets",
      headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "acme" },
      params: { password_reset: { email: "avery@example.test" } },
      as: :json
    assert_response :ok
    reset_token = extract_token_from_last_email

    post "/api/v1/password_resets/confirm",
      headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "acme" },
      params: { password_reset: { token: reset_token, password: "new-customer-password" } },
      as: :json
    assert_response :ok

    # Old session invalidated
    get "/api/v1/me",
      headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "acme", "Authorization" => "Bearer #{customer_token}" }
    assert_response :unauthorized

    # Can sign in with new password
    post "/api/v1/sessions",
      headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "acme" },
      params: { session: { email: "avery@example.test", password: "new-customer-password" } },
      as: :json
    assert_response :created
  end

  test "customer opens request, staff replies with status and notes, customer reopens or marks solved" do
    owner_token, owner_id = create_account_and_owner
    avery_token, avery_id = register_verify_signin_customer

    # Agent on Acme
    acme = Account.find_by!(subdomain: "acme")
    agent = acme.users.create!(
      name: "Agent Bob",
      email: "bob@acme.test",
      password: "agent-password",
      role: "agent",
      verified: true,
      verified_at: Time.current
    )
    post "/api/v1/sessions",
      headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "acme" },
      params: { session: { email: "bob@acme.test", password: "agent-password" } },
      as: :json
    assert_response :created
    agent_token = json_body.dig("session", "token")

    # Customer opens a request
    travel_to Time.utc(2026, 11, 22, 10, 0, 0) do
      post "/api/v1/requests",
        headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "acme", "Authorization" => "Bearer #{avery_token}" },
        params: {
          request: {
            subject: "Cannot download my receipt",
            comment: { body: "The download button does nothing." }
          }
        },
        as: :json
    end
    assert_response :created
    assert_equal 0, ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.size

    req = json_body["request"]
    assert_not_nil req
    ticket_id = req["id"]
    assert_equal "Cannot download my receipt", req["subject"]
    assert_equal "open", req["status"]
    assert_equal avery_id, req["requester_id"]
    assert_not_nil req["created_at"]
    assert_not_nil req["updated_at"]
    assert_nil req["requester"]

    # Staff sees ticket with requester object
    get "/api/v1/tickets/#{ticket_id}",
      headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "acme", "Authorization" => "Bearer #{owner_token}" }
    assert_response :ok
    ticket = json_body["ticket"]
    assert_equal ticket_id, ticket["id"]
    assert_equal "Cannot download my receipt", ticket["subject"]
    assert_equal "open", ticket["status"]
    assert_equal avery_id, ticket["requester_id"]
    assert_equal(
      { "id" => avery_id, "name" => "Avery", "email" => "avery@example.test" },
      ticket["requester"]
    )

    # Owner replies and marks ticket pending
    travel_to Time.utc(2026, 11, 22, 10, 5, 0) do
      patch "/api/v1/tickets/#{ticket_id}",
        headers: { "X-Helpdesk-Account" => "acme", "Authorization" => "Bearer #{owner_token}" },
        params: {
          ticket: {
            comment: { body: "Please try again now." },
            status: "pending"
          }
        },
        as: :json
    end
    assert_response :ok
    assert_equal "pending", json_body.dig("ticket", "status")
    assert_equal 0, ActionMailer::Base.deliveries.size

    # Agent posts a private note without status -> status stays pending
